name: fairclinic-ppo-writeoffs
description: Fairclinic PPO Write-offs: dental adjustments and write-offs split into contractual (PPO) and discretionary, with write-off percent of production by carrier and discretionary adjustments by the person who entered them; flags duplicates, contractual write-offs for out-of-network carriers or no carrier, adjustments without a reason, and large ones. Patient names are masked before results reach the model.
